title.narrative: Program to Support a Fair, Clean and Sustainable Energy Transition I
Programa de Apoyo a una Transicin Energtica Justa, Limpia y Sostenible I

description.narrative: El objetivo general de la serie programtica es apoyar un desarrollo sostenible bajo en emisiones e inclusivo de Panam, a travs de una transicin energtica limpia, justa e inclusiva. Los objetivos especficos de la primera operacin son: (i) fomentar el incremento de la generacin de fuentes renovables variables en la matriz de generacin; (ii) incentivar la digitalizacin del sector elctrico; (iii) fomentar la movilidad elctrica; (iv) apoyar a incrementar el acceso a electricidad; (v) apoyar a la reduccin de la brecha de gnero en el sector; y (vi) fomentar la creacin de capacidades en empleo verde para la transicin energtica.

The general objective of the programmatic series is to support a low-emission and inclusive sustainable development of Panama, through a clean, fair and inclusive energy transition. The specific objectives of the first operation are: (i) promote the increase in the generation of variable renewable sources in the generation matrix; (ii) encourage digitalization of the electricity sector; (iii) promote electric mobility; (iv) support increasing access to electricity; (v) support the reduction of the gender gap in the sector; and (vi) promote the creation of capacities in green employment for the energy transition.
